question: 各个品类的销售额、销量情况分布
gold_sql: select c.category_name, sum(oi.subtotal),sum(oi.quantity)from order_items oi left JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id left join products p on oi.product_id = p.product_id left join categories c on p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE o.status = '已完成'group by c.category_name
raw_output:
SELECT 
    c.category_name AS category,
    SUM(oi.subtotal) AS sales_amount,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_volume
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE 
    o.status = '已完成'
GROUP BY 
    c.category_id, c.category_name
ORDER BY 
    sales_amount DESC
